summary: Phase 3 (Dealer vs Customer split) verified end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest tests passed (test_phase3_split.py). Frontend flows all working: login page has 3 role tabs, dealers/customers admin pages show correct data, employee home has both card-dealers & card-customers, visit party-type toggle switches between dealer/customer dropdowns, enquiry lists farmers only, sales/collection list dealers only, dealer login lands on /shop with dealer_code visible.

issues: Visit Date & Next Follow-up use browser's default date input instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker component. Consistent to fix across app if desired.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <input type='date'> pickers with the shadcn Calendar component for a consistent look across Visit / Enquiry / Sales / Collection forms.
(Optional) Add data-testid to card-visits and card-enquiries on Employee Home for future testability (currently only card-dealers, card-customers, card-sales exist).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now ~1800+ lines with the added dealer/customer split — consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth, users, visits, orders, analytics) for maintainability.

role_hint='customer' auto-registration path silently creates new customer users; ensure phone uniqueness across tenant and a rate-limit / captcha before going to production to prevent spam farmer accounts.

Enquiry creation from a logged-in customer overrides customer_id server-side — good. Verify same protection exists on POST /api/orders when role='customer' (customer_id/user_id should be forced to auth user).
GET /api/analytics/tenant nests dealers/customers inside 'kpis' — documented but worth adding OpenAPI response schema for stability.
